podcast.body: This song was performed live at Joy Division's final concert at Birmingham University. After its conclusion, singer Ian Curtis fainted on stage, suffering an epileptic seizure. The audience, accustomed to his "herky, jerky way of dancing," initially believed it was part of the act and cheered. "That's joy division with a live version of Decades. And part of the reason the crowd is cheering right now is because singer Ian Curris has just fainted on stage."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
